overview: The ICR app is on the App Store and Google Play as **ICR**. It uses the same account as the website icr.org.in: one email and password for both, and what you do in one shows in the other.
before: A phone connected to the internet, with the ICR app installed.
To join: access to your email and your mobile phone, since ICR sends a code to each.

rules: **Continue with LinkedIn** and **Continue with Google** open that account's own sign-in page. If you already have an ICR account with the same email, you are signed in to it.
After several wrong passwords in a row the account is locked for a few minutes. Wait, or reset the password.
The link in the email works once and expires after an hour.
For your privacy the app gives the same answer whether or not the address has an account.

The mobile number step is in the app from version 1.0.0 build 14. If your app stops on this screen asking for a mobile number it has no box for, update the app, or join at icr.org.in and sign in here.
An address that already has an ICR account is told so, with **Sign in instead**.
Everyone joins as a professional. Hiring, buying and selling start later, from a company page.

faq.q: I signed up with Google or LinkedIn and never set a password. Can I sign in with email?
faq.a: Yes. Use **Forgot password?** with the email of that account; the link lets you set a password for the first time.
Yes, when **Remember me** is ticked, until you sign out.
